verdict.rationale: A GPU cloud with a provisioning API could plausibly offer a sandbox or test-mode environment, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents a sandbox, test mode, or staging environment isolated from production data. Workspaces, firewall rules and disposable on-demand instances are adjacent features that a user could arrange into isolation themselves; they are not a product-provided sandbox, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
